headline: Ex-MP Bodi and 3 army officials sent to jail over councillor killing
summary: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 ordered the detention of former Cox's Bazar-4 MP Abdur Rahman Bodi and three retired army officers in a crimes against humanity case.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 has sent former Cox's Bazar-4 MP Abdur Rahman Bodi and three retired army officials to jail. They were shown arrested in a case involving crimes against humanity regarding the killing of Teknaf councillor Ekramul Haque.
caption:
Former MP Abdur Rahman Bodi and three retired army officers are behind bars. They face charges of orchestrating a staged gunfight to kill a local councillor.

The International Crimes Tribunal-2 has sent former Cox's Bazar-4 MP Abdur Rahman Bodi and three retired army officials to jail. They were shown arrested in a case involving crimes against humanity regarding the killing of Teknaf councillor Ekramul Haque.

headline_marked: DMP [[bans gatherings and weapons]] around Parliament ahead of session
headline: DMP bans gatherings and weapons around Parliament ahead of session
summary: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police have prohibited all rallies, processions, and the carriage of weapons or explosives in several key areas to ensure the third session of the 13th National Parliament runs smoothly.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) have banned all gatherings, rallies, processions, and protests in various parts of the capital to ensure the third session of the 13th National Parliament concludes without disruption.
// The ban is effective from 12:00 AM on Wednesday, August 26, and will remain in place until the session ends.
The prohibition includes a ban on carrying weapons, explosives, harmful or polluting substances, and any form of assembly or demonstration in the designated areas.

The restricted zones include the stretch from Mohakhali Crossing on Mymensingh Road to Banglamotor Crossing via the Old Airport, and from the west end of Banglamotor Link Road to the Circle Fountain on Hotel Sonargaon Road.
Other banned areas include the east end of Panthapath to the Farmgate junction via Green Road, and the Shyamoli intersection on Mirpur Road to the junction of Dhanmondi Road 16 (formerly 27).

The ban also covers the junction of Rokeya Sarani to the Bijoy Sarani Tourism Crossing via the Old Ninth Division (Uttara Jahaj) crossing, and the east end of Indira Road to the west end of Manik Mia Avenue.
The National Parliament House's reserved area and all roads and alleys within these defined boundaries are also strictly included under the this restriction.
caption:
No rallies or weapons allowed. The DMP has banned gatherings in key Dhaka areas to secure the upcoming Parliament session.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) have banned all gatherings, rallies, processions, and protests in various parts of the capital to ensure the third session of the 13th National Parliament concludes without disruption.

// The ban is effective from 12:00 AM on Wednesday, August 26, and will remain in place until the session ends.

The prohibition includes a ban on carrying weapons, explosives, harmful or polluting substances, and any form of assembly or demonstration in the designated areas.

The restricted zones include the stretch from Mohakhali Crossing on Mymensingh Road to Banglamotor Crossing via the Old Airport, and from the west end of Banglamotor Link Road to the Circle Fountain on Hotel Sonargaon Road.

Other banned areas include the east end of Panthapath to the Farmgate junction via Green Road, and the Shyamoli intersection on Mirpur Road to the junction of Dhanmondi Road 16 (formerly 27).

The ban also covers the junction of Rokeya Sarani to the Bijoy Sarani Tourism Crossing via the Old Ninth Division (Uttara Jahaj) crossing, and the east end of Indira Road to the west end of Manik Mia Avenue.

The National Parliament House's reserved area and all roads and alleys within these defined boundaries are also strictly included under the this restriction.
